 LISA Drops Emotional New Single ‘Leave With Me’ From ‘Always Lalisa’ Movie: Listen
 The swaying ballad plays over the end credits of the documentary now playing exclusively on YouTube Premium.
 By
 Gil Kaufman

 LLOUD/ YouTube

 BLACKPINK ‘S LISA had a special surprise for her fans at the kick-off of her sold-out VIVA LA LISA residency in Las Vegas at The Colosseum at Caesars Palace last weekend. In addition to such beloved tracks as “Rockstar,” “Money,” “Moonlit Floor” and “Born Again,” the fourth act of the show ended with a brand new song from her recently released Always Lalisa documentary.

 The swoony ballad “Leave With Me” plays over the end credits of the film about LISA’s rise to solo prominence outside of the K-pop girl group juggernaut and it finds the singer in a contemplative mood as she ponders confidently taking flight on her own in search of new adventures.
 The song, co-written by LISA along with Feli Ferraro, Tyler Spry, Ali Tamposi and Shintaro Yasuda, opens with a gently plucked acoustic guitar as LISA breathily sings, “Yesterday/ Kiss it goodbye/ Wipe my eyes dry/ Hold my head high/ I leave with me/ Check the clock/ Yeah it’s my time/ Spread my wings fly.” 
 The accompanying video features footage from the feature doc directed by Sue Kim that premiered in September at the 2026 Toronto International Film Festival before a limited theatrical release in IMAX last month; the movie is available to stream exclusively on YouTube Premium now.
 LISA, the first K-pop artist to launch a Vegas residency, mixed her favorite songs and solo hits with some unexpected tracks during the launch of her residency, including the live debuts of “Cut U Off” and “Cobra,” as well as the world premiere of “Leave With Me.” 
 Riding a slow-motion drum beat and spare arrangement, LISA get into her emotions in the new song, thanking an ex for letting her go so she can find the place where she truly belongs. “You know that there’s no hard feelings/ Every wrong and right/ Put me right where I’m supposed to be,” she sings with quiet confidence on the track that has a languid, Kacey Musgraves ballad vibe. “No hard feelings/ You can come or stay/ Either way, I’mma leave with me.” 
 LISA will be back on stage in Vegas for the next Viva La Lisa dates on Nov. 27, 28 and 29.
